semiconductor_relevance: High — RFPT Co., Ltd. provides essential RF power solutions for plasma processes critical to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: RFPT Co., Ltd. specializes in high-frequency RF power solutions, particularly for plasma applications such as etching and deposition in semiconductor manufacturing. The company serves major global semiconductor manufacturers, providing a range of RF generators, matchers, and vacuum valves.
capabilities: Vacuum valves including gate and butterfly valves

regional_presence.Korea: RFPT Co., Ltd. has major customers including Samsung Electronics and Wonik IPS in Korea.
